meta.scope: Merged purposive research index; account routes, not a census of mediums.
meta.durationDefinition: Arithmetic mean of available eligible video durations in the indexed sample.
meta.frequencyDefinition: Counts of indexed videos with exact reported upload dates; not a channel posting rate.
meta.textMethod: Transparent keyword indicators plus identity-masked TF-IDF titles.
meta.transcriptStatus: Separate bounded caption pilot; see transcripts section.
meta.titleLanguagePolicy: langdetect1.0.9 seed42: English probability≥0.80 and≥4alphabetic words. Statistical heuristic; short titles may be excluded. Current watch-page titles supersede supplied translations, with variants retained.
